body.zh-Hant: 山口多聞（1892—1942）是大正、昭和時期的海軍中將，明治25年（1892）8月17日生，出生於東京市小石川區表町（今東京都文京區），是山口宗義的三男。他於明治45年（1912）自海軍兵學校畢業，大正15年（1926）畢業於海軍大學；年輕軍官時期曾赴美國，在普林斯頓大學留學。
body.en: Yamaguchi Tamon (1892-1942) was a Taisho- and Showa-era vice admiral. Born on 17 August 1892 in Koishikawa-ku Omotecho, Tokyo City (now Bunkyo Ward), he was the third son of Yamaguchi Munetada. He graduated from the Naval Academy in 1912 and from the Naval War College in 1926, and as a young officer he studied in the United States at Princeton University.

heading.en: Attache, staff officer and ship captain

body.zh-Hant: 據辭典所載，他在大佐時代以大使館附武官的身分駐在華盛頓，並擔任過倫敦裁軍會議的隨員與第五艦隊參謀長，也曾任巡洋艦「五十鈴」的艦長。這些職務的起迄年月，兩部辭典都沒有寫明，因此本文不列任期。
body.en: According to the dictionaries, as a captain he was stationed in Washington as an embassy attache, served as a member of the staff at the London naval disarmament conference and as chief of staff of the Fifth Fleet, and also commanded the cruiser Isuzu. Neither dictionary states when these posts began or ended, so no terms are given here.

heading.en: 2nd Carrier Division and the Battle of Midway

body.zh-Hant: 太平洋戰爭中，他任第二航空戰隊司令官，搭乘空母「飛龍」；昭和17年（1942）6月5日在中途島海戰中戰死，享年51歲，死後追晉海軍中將。
body.en: In the Pacific War he commanded the 2nd Carrier Division aboard the aircraft carrier Hiryu. He was killed in the Battle of Midway on 5 June 1942, aged 51, and was posthumously made a vice admiral.

body.zh-Hant: 山縣有朋（1838—1922）是明治、大正時期的政治家與元老，官至陸軍大將、元帥。他生於長州藩下級士族山縣有稔家，為長子，在萩城下出生，就學於松下村塾，1863年任奇兵隊軍監。1864年他參加下關戰爭，1866年參加第二次幕長戰爭；戊辰戰爭中任北陸道鎮撫總督兼會津征討越後口總督參謀，轉戰越後與奧羽。1869年他奉藩主之命赴歐視察各國軍制，翌年歸國，任兵部少輔。
body.en: Yamagata Aritomo (1838-1922) was a Meiji- and Taisho-era politician and genro who rose to army general and field marshal. The eldest son of Yamagata Aritoshi, a lower samurai of Choshu domain, he was born in Hagi castle town, studied at the Shokason-juku, and became military inspector of the Kiheitai in 1863. He served in the Shimonoseki War in 1864 and the Second Choshu Expedition in 1866; in the Boshin War he was staff officer to the commander-in-chief of the Hokurikudo pacification force and of the Aizu expedition's Echigo front, campaigning in Echigo and Oshu. In 1869, on the daimyo's orders, he toured Europe to study military systems, returning in 1870 to become junior vice-minister of military affairs.

citations.quote: 明治・大正期の政治家、元老。陸軍大将、元帥。
天保(てんぽう)9年6月14日、長州藩(ちょうしゅうはん)下級士族山県有稔(ありとし)の長男として萩(はぎ)城下に生まれる
松下村塾(しょうかそんじゅく)に学ぶ

北陸道鎮撫総督兼会津征討越後口総督参謀
維新後の1869年（明治2）渡欧、各国軍制を視察し翌1870年帰国
1864（元治元）年下関戦争に従軍。1866（慶応2）年第二次幕長戦争に従軍。
1869年毛利敬親の命にて渡欧。1870年帰国。同年兵部少輔。
1863（文久3）年奇兵隊軍監。

heading.zh-Hant: 建軍、佐賀之亂與西南戰爭
heading.en: Building the army, the Saga and Satsuma campaigns

body.zh-Hant: 他繼承大村益次郎的遺志主張徵兵制，1873年實現，奠定近代軍制的基礎；同年陸軍省設置後出任陸軍卿，1874年兼任參議。同年佐賀之亂，他以征討參軍身分從軍；1877年西南戰爭中亦任征討參軍，率領徵兵組成的新軍，與以士族為中心的西鄉軍對決並加以鎮壓，這兩場戰役都由他出征。1878年依德國模式設置參謀本部，他任首任參謀本部長；1882年起草並頒布軍人敕諭，同年改任參事院議長兼參謀本部御用掛，1884年再兼參謀本部長。
body.en: Carrying on the aims of Omura Masujiro, he advocated conscription and realised it in 1873, laying the foundation of the modern military system; when the Army Ministry was set up that year he became army minister, and in 1874 also a councillor. In 1874 he served as expeditionary staff commander in the Saga Rebellion, and in the Satsuma Rebellion of 1877 again went to the front in that post, leading the new conscript army against the samurai-centred force of Saigo and putting it down. In 1878 the General Staff was established on the German model with him as its first chief; in 1882 he drafted and issued the Imperial Rescript to Soldiers and Sailors and became president of the Sanjiin and attaché to the General Staff, and in 1884 he again held the General Staff chief post concurrently.

citations.quote: 大村益次郎(おおむらますじろう)の志を継ぎ徴兵制を主張し、1873年これを実現、近代軍制の基礎を築いた
同年陸軍省設置により陸軍卿(きょう)となり参議を兼任
西南戦争にも征討参軍として出征，徴兵による新しい軍隊を率いて士族中心の西郷軍と対決，これを鎮圧した
西南戦争後の1878年にはドイツに倣って参謀本部を設置し軍政・軍令機関の二元化を行い、初代参謀本部長の任にあたった
1882年には軍人勅諭を起案、頒布し、天皇制軍隊の精神的基礎を固めた
1874年佐賀の乱に征討参軍として従軍。同年参議兼陸軍卿。
1877年西南戦争に征討参軍として従軍。1878年参謀本部長。
1882年軍人勅諭制定に携わる。同年参事院議長兼参謀本部御用掛。
1883年内務卿。1884年兼参謀本部長。

heading.zh-Hant: 甲午戰爭與第一軍（平壤戰役）
heading.en: First Army in the Sino-Japanese War (Pyongyang campaign)

body.zh-Hant: 1894年9月，第一軍以第三師團與第五師團為基幹編成，司令官為山縣有朋。他在朝鮮仁川上陸時，野津道貫的第五師團已在進行平壤作戰，他遂將指揮一任野津，並攻下平壤；10月軍隊北進至鴨綠江畔，11月占領義州並侵入滿洲。12月初旬他被召回，由野津接任第一軍司令官；日本大百科全書則稱他因病歸國。第一軍此後占領海城，並在1895年3月的牛莊之戰後控制遼東半島一帶。
body.en: In September 1894 the First Army was formed around the 3rd and 5th Divisions with Yamagata Aritomo as commander. When he landed at Incheon, the Pyongyang operation was already under way under Nozu Michitsura of the 5th Division, so he left command to Nozu and Pyongyang was taken; in October the army advanced to the Yalu, in November it occupied Uiju and entered Manchuria. In early December he was recalled and Nozu became First Army commander (the Nihon Daihyakka Zensho says he returned home ill). The army then took Haicheng and, after the Battle of Niuzhuang in March 1895, held the Liaodong area.

citations.quote: 1894（明治27）年9月第3師団と第5師団を基幹として編成された。司令官は山縣有朋。
山縣が朝鮮の仁川に上陸した時、既に野津道貫第５師団長指揮下で平壌作戦が進行していたため、指揮を野津に一任し平壌を攻略した。
同年10月朝鮮半島を北進して鴨緑江畔に達し、11月義州を占拠し、さらに満洲に侵入した。
12月初旬山縣は召喚され、野津が第１軍司令官に任じられた。
日清戦争では第一軍司令官として出征したが、病気で帰国
同月中旬海城を占領した。1895年３月牛荘の戦いを経て、遼東半島一帯を勢力下に治めた。

heading.zh-Hant: 內閣、樞密院與日俄戰爭
heading.en: Cabinets, Privy Council and the Russo-Japanese War

body.zh-Hant: 1889年他組織第一次山縣內閣，1891年內閣總辭；1893年任樞密院議長，1895年任陸軍大臣。1898年獲元帥稱號，同年再組第二次山縣內閣，1900年義和團事件時派出最大規模的軍隊赴中國，與列強合作。日俄戰爭中他於1904年以參謀總長兼兵站總監（日本大百科全書作「兵站總督」）的身分列席大本營，1907年因功晉升公爵。
body.en: In 1889 he formed the first Yamagata cabinet, which resigned in 1891; he became president of the Privy Council in 1893 and army minister in 1895. He received the title of field marshal in 1898 and formed his second cabinet that year; during the Boxer incident of 1900 he sent the largest army to China, cooperating with the Powers. In the Russo-Japanese War he served from 1904 as chief of the General Staff and concurrently commissary general (the Nihon Daihyakka Zensho writes 'heitan sotoku') in the Imperial Headquarters, and in 1907 was raised to prince for his service.

citations.quote: 1889年第一次山県内閣を組織

body.zh-Hant: 1909年伊藤博文遇刺後，他的元老地位更為鞏固。第二次西園寺公望內閣末期，因增設二個師團問題陸相辭職，他拒絕推薦後任陸相，致使內閣倒台。1918年米騷動之後，他推舉政友會總裁原敬為首相。1921年皇太子妃選定問題（宮中某重大事件）中他處置失敗，翌年（大正11年）2月1日在失意中去世，舉行國葬。
body.en: After the assassination of Ito Hirobumi in 1909 his position as genro grew stronger. At the end of the second Saionji cabinet, when the army minister resigned over the question of two additional divisions, he refused to recommend a successor and so brought the cabinet down. After the 1918 rice riots he recommended Hara Takashi, president of the Seiyukai, as prime minister. He failed in the 1921 crown-princess selection affair (the "Imperial Court incident"), and died on 1 February 1922 in disappointment; a state funeral was held.

body.zh-Hant: 嶋田繁太郎（1883—1976）是大正、昭和時期的海軍大將，曾任海相，明治16年（1883）9月24日生，東京出身。他於明治37年（1904）畢業於海軍兵學校第32期，大正4年（1915）畢業於海軍大學。大正5年至8年任駐義大利大使館附武官，返國後歷任「多摩」「比叡」兩艦艦長與第二艦隊參謀長。
body.en: Shimada Shigetaro (1883-1976) was a Taisho- and Showa-era admiral and navy minister, born on 24 September 1883 and a native of Tokyo. He graduated from the Naval Academy (32nd class) in 1904 and the Naval War College in 1915. From 1916 to 1919 he was naval attache at the embassy in Italy, and after returning home he captained the Tama and the Hiei and served as chief of staff of the Second Fleet.

body.zh-Hant: 昭和5年（1930）他任第一艦隊兼聯合艦隊參謀長，7年任第三艦隊參謀長，8年任軍令部作戰部長；10年升任軍令部次長，並推動廢棄海軍裁軍條約。
body.en: In 1930 he became chief of staff of the First Fleet and the Combined Fleet, in 1932 chief of staff of the Third Fleet, and in 1933 head of the Operations Department of the Naval General Staff; in 1935 he became vice chief of the Naval General Staff and pushed for the abrogation of the naval arms-limitation treaty.

body.en: After the outbreak of the Sino-Japanese War he successively served as commander-in-chief of the Second Fleet and of the Kure Naval District, became commander-in-chief of the China Area Fleet in 1940, and was promoted to full admiral that year.

body.zh-Hant: 昭和16年（1941）他由橫須賀鎮守府長官轉任東條內閣的海相，主張開戰。19年2月兼任軍令部總長，7月因塞班島陷落辭去海相；另一部辭典說他在馬里亞納海戰失敗後辭職。戰後他被判A級戰犯終身刑，昭和30年（1955）獲釋，昭和51年（1976）6月7日去世。
body.en: In 1941 he moved from commander of the Yokosuka Naval District to navy minister in the Tojo cabinet and argued for war. In February 1944 he also became chief of the Naval General Staff, and in July resigned as navy minister after the fall of Saipan; another dictionary says he resigned after the defeat in the Battle of the Philippine Sea. After the war he was sentenced as a Class A war criminal to life imprisonment, was released in 1955, and died on 7 June 1976.

body.zh-Hant: 木村兵太郎（1888—1948）是昭和時期的陸軍大將，明治21年（1888）9月28日生，埼玉縣出身。他畢業於陸軍士官學校第20期，大正5年（1916）畢業於陸軍大學。明治41年任野砲第16聯隊附，陸大畢業後駐在德國，歷任砲兵監部部員，昭和4年任參謀本部部員。
body.en: Kimura Heitaro (1888-1948) was a Showa-era army general, born on 28 September 1888 in Saitama Prefecture. He graduated from the Army Academy (20th class) and the Army War College in 1916. He was attached to the 16th Field Artillery Regiment in 1908, was stationed in Germany after the War College, served on the Artillery Inspectorate, and in 1929 became a General Staff officer.

body.en: He accompanied the London naval conference that year; from 1935 he was head of the Control Section of the War Ministry Equipment Bureau and then head of the Ordnance Bureau, in 1939 commanded the 32nd Division, serving at Jinan in China, and in 1940 became chief of staff of the Kwantung Army.

citations.quote: 同年ロンドン軍縮会議随員、10年から陸軍省整備局統制課長、同兵器局長、14年第32師団長として中国済南に従軍、15年関東軍参謀長

body.zh-Hant: 昭和16年至18年（1941—1943），他在東條英機陸相之下擔任陸軍次官。
body.en: From 1941 to 1943 he served as vice minister of war under War Minister Tojo Hideki.

citations.quote: 16〜18年東条英機陸相の下、陸軍次官

body.zh-Hant: 昭和19年（1944）他任緬甸方面軍司令官，在英帕爾作戰失敗後負責重整，20年5月晉升大將。戰敗後他在東京審判中被追究「緬甸屠夫」的責任，昭和23年（1948）12月23日以A級戰犯身分被處絞刑。
body.en: In 1944 he became commander of the Burma Area Army and took on the rebuilding after the failure of the Imphal operation, and he was promoted to full general in May 1945. After the defeat he was held responsible at the Tokyo trial as the "Butcher of Burma" and was hanged as a Class A war criminal on 23 December 1948.

heading.en: The Burma campaign and the surrender

body.zh-Hant: 昭和19年（1944），木村兵太郎出任緬甸方面軍司令官，在英帕爾作戰失敗後負責重整緬甸戰役的局面。終戰時，8月15日方面軍司令部設在毛淡棉（モールメン）市內的山坡上；方面軍占領地區維持治安，並依8月27日在仰光（蘭貢）達成的停戰暫定協定準備解除武裝，把第三十三軍等部隊分別集結到指定地點。
body.en: In 1944 Kimura Heitaro became commander of the Burma Area Army and took charge of restoring the situation after the failed Imphal operation. At the surrender, the army headquarters stood on a hillside in Moulmein on 15 August. The army kept order in its occupied areas, prepared to disarm under the provisional armistice agreement of 27 August at Rangoon, and had units such as the 33rd Army concentrate at designated places in the Burma campaign's final phase.

body.zh-Hant: 松井石根（1878—1948）是陸軍大將，明治11年（1878）7月27日生於名古屋，明治30年（1897）畢業於陸軍士官學校，在陸軍大學就讀期間從軍參加日俄戰爭。1906年至1919年他任參謀本部員，其間兩度駐在中國，前後共8年。他1918年任大佐，1923年少將，1927年中將，1933年晉升大將，1935年轉入預備役。
body.en: Matsui Iwane (1878-1948) was an army general, born on 27 July 1878 in Nagoya. He graduated from the Army Academy in 1897 and served in the Russo-Japanese War while at the Army War College. From 1906 to 1919 he was a General Staff officer, stationed in China twice for a total of eight years. He became a colonel in 1918, major general in 1923, lieutenant general in 1927 and full general in 1933, and was placed on the reserve list in 1935.

citations.quote: 明治11年7月27日、名古屋に生まれる
1897年（明治30）陸軍士官学校卒業
陸軍大学校在学中、日露戦争に従軍
1906年（明治39）から1919年まで参謀本部員、その間中国に駐在すること前後2回8か年に及び
1918年（大正7）大佐、1923年少将、1927年（昭和2）中将、1933年大将に昇進し、1935年予備役となる

body.zh-Hant: 他歷任步兵第29聯隊長、浦鹽派遣軍參謀、哈爾濱特務機關長、第35旅團長；其後任參謀本部第2部長、第11師團長、日內瓦一般裁軍會議全權委員、台灣軍司令官與軍事參議官。
body.en: He held posts as commander of the 29th Infantry Regiment, staff officer of the Vladivostok expeditionary force, head of the Harbin special service agency and commander of the 35th Brigade; he then served as chief of the Second Department of the General Staff, commander of the 11th Division, plenipotentiary to the Geneva general disarmament conference, commander of the Taiwan Army, and supreme military councillor.

citations.quote: 歩兵第二九連隊長、浦塩(ウラジオ)派遣軍参謀、ハルビン特務機関長、第三五旅団長
参謀本部第二部長、第一一師団長、ジュネーブ一般軍縮会議全権委員、台湾軍司令官、軍参議官を歴任した

heading.en: Shanghai Expeditionary Army and Central China Area Army

body.zh-Hant: 1937年日中戰爭爆發，他回任現役，8月任上海派遣軍司令官，10月任中支那方面軍司令官，攻陷首都南京，翌年（1938）3月復員。同年7月他任內閣參議官，其後又任大政翼贊會興亞總本部總理。
body.en: When the Sino-Japanese War broke out in 1937 he returned to active service, becoming commander of the Shanghai Expeditionary Army in August and of the Central China Area Army in October; he took the capital Nanjing and was demobilised in March 1938. In July of that year he became a cabinet councillor and later head of the Asia Development headquarters of the Imperial Rule Assistance Association.

body.zh-Hant: 他長年主張大亞細亞主義，晚年隱居於熱海伊豆山。戰敗後，遠東國際軍事審判以占領南京時的大暴行責任判他死刑，昭和23年（1948）12月23日行刑。
body.en: He long advocated Pan-Asianism and in later life lived in seclusion at Izusan in Atami. After the defeat the International Military Tribunal for the Far East sentenced him to death for the great atrocities committed during the occupation of Nanjing, and he was executed on 23 December 1948.
